name: SoundBoard
description: A sound-effects board for OVOS - 'play a drum roll', 'play applause', 'play an air horn'. Same bundled-CC0-sample pattern as ovos-skill-sound-like, but for stock sound effects rather than animal/object sounds. Could plausibly share infrastructure with ovos-skill-sound-like rather than being fully separate - worth revisiting once both exist.
author: andlo

da-dk.name: SoundBoard
da-dk.description: Et lydeffekt-braet til OVOS - 'spil en trommehvirvel', 'spil klapsalve', 'spil et luft-horn'. Samme bundlede-CC0-sample-moenster som ovos-skill-sound-like, men for standard lydeffekter fremfor dyre-/objektlyde. Kunne plausibelt dele infrastruktur med ovos-skill-sound-like fremfor at vaere helt separat - vaerd at genbesoege naar begge findes.
